subject: general
question: Recipient of Padma Shri in 2025, Shri Onkar Singh Pahwa, is related to which cycle company of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avon Cycles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Onkar Singh Pahwa**, a recipient of the **Padma Shri in 2025**, is associated with **Avon Cycles**, one of the leading cycle manufacturers in India.
 
• **Avon Cycles** was established in **1951** and has grown to become one of India’s largest cycle manufacturers, contributing significantly to the cycling industry. *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• **Shri Onkar Singh Pahwa** has played an instrumental role in modernizing and expanding Avon Cycles, making it a household name in India. His contributions have been recognized through the prestigious Padma Shri award. *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• Avon Cycles is known for producing a wide range of cycles, including basic models for everyday use, high-end sports cycles, and eco-friendly options. The company has significantly contributed to promoting cycling as a sustainable and healthy mode of transportation in India.
 
• The Padma Shri award recognizes individuals who have made extraordinary contributions in various fields, including industry and trade, which is why Shri Onkar Singh Pahwa’s association with Avon Cycles was deemed worthy of the honor. *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Avon Cycles.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Avon Cycles:**

 
 
• **Established:** Avon Cycles was founded in **1951** in **Ludhiana, Punjab**, India.
 
• **Key Products:** Avon Cycles produces a variety of cycles, including standard bicycles, sports bicycles, and electric bicycles. It caters to both domestic and international markets.
 
• **Global Reach:** Avon Cycles exports bicycles to over **80 countries**, earning recognition as a global brand in the cycle manufacturing industry.
 
• **Eco-Friendly Initiatives:** Avon Cycles promotes sustainable transportation through its range of eco-friendly bicycles and electric cycles.
 
• **Recognition:** The company has received various awards and accolades for its contribution to the cycling industry, including the leadership and innovation brought by Shri Onkar Singh Pahwa.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri Award:**
 
 
• **Significance:** The Padma Shri is India’s fourth-highest civilian award, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• **Year of Award:** Shri Onkar Singh Pahwa received the Padma Shri in **2025** for his exceptional contributions to the cycle manufacturing industry.
 
• **Criteria:** Recipients are selected based on their impact and achievements in their respective fields, showcasing excellence, innovation, and dedication.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Cycle Companies in India:**

 
 
• **Hero Cycles:** Founded in **1956**, Hero Cycles is the world’s largest bicycle manufacturer, headquartered in **Ludhiana, Punjab**.
 
• **Atlas Cycles:** Established in **1951**, Atlas Cycles is known for producing high-quality bicycles and being an iconic brand in India.
 
• **Tata Stryder:** Tata Stryder is a relatively modern brand, offering premium bicycles and promoting sustainable transportation solutions.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Cycling Industry:**
 
 
• **Economic Contribution:** The cycling industry in India generates employment and contributes significantly to the economy through manufacturing and exports.
 
• **Environmental Benefits:** Cycling promotes eco-friendly transportation, reducing carbon emissions and encouraging healthy lifestyles.
